summary: CE OS supports CLI over SSH (network_cli) and NETCONF (XML over SSH), both with SSH keys or -u/-k, bastion access, and no enable mode; connection local is deprecated.
questions: What connection types does CloudEngine support?
Does CloudEngine support enable mode in Ansible?
Can I use connection local with CloudEngine?

answer_card.title: CloudEngine connections
answer_card.answer_md:
| | CLI | NETCONF |
|---|---|---|
| Protocol | SSH | XML over SSH |
| Credentials | SSH keys/agent, or `-u myuser -k` | same |
| Indirect access | bastion/jump host | bastion/jump host |
| `ansible_connection` | `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | `ansible.netcommon.netconf` |
| Enable mode | not supported | not supported |

`ansible_connection: local` is deprecated.
